text.Federation Shipyard:
How to Play ==
When you play Federation Shipyard you gain 2 Trade and you put a Outpost with a defense strength of 6 into play. When the ally ability triggers you may put the next ship or base you acquire this turn on top of your deck.
 Strategy ==
For 6 trade you get an Outpost with a decent defense value of 6 and it is adding 2 trade when in play. Great asset of this base comes to live when the ally ability triggers.
